//: A Windows Terminal *fragment* for Rexo Code — gives it its own tab icon and name instead of the generic PowerShell one. Windows Terminal doesn't read an exe's embedded icon resource for its own tab; it only looks at a profile's own "icon" field, which is why this is a separate file rather than something rexo.exe can set at runtime (see cli::tui::set_console_title's doc comment for the full breakdown of title vs. icon).
//install: Copy this file to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows Terminal\Fragments\RexoCode\rexo.json (create the folders if needed) and restart Windows Terminal — it'll pick up 'Rexo Code' as a profile in the New Tab dropdown automatically. No edit to your own settings.json required.
